9. Identify true statements regarding rhombic sulphur and monoclinic sulphur.
(a) Both are crystalline and insoluble in $\mathrm{CS}_2$.
(b) Both are amorphous and soluble in $\mathrm{CS}_2$.
(c) Both are crystalline and soluble in $\mathrm{CS}_2$.
(d) Both are amorphous and insoluble in $\mathrm{CS}_2$.

10. Sugar, on treating with sulphuric acid, turns to a black coloured mass. The
property of sulphuric acid exploited in this process is ________.
(a) Acid nature (b) Oxidizing property
(c) Dehydrating property (d) Bleaching property

11. Aqueous solutions of two metal sulphates on treatment with hydrogen sul-
phide separately give flesh coloured and white precipitates. What are the
two metals?
(a) Mn, Zn (b) Pb, Cu
(c) Pb, Mn (d) Zn, Cu

12. Identify 'X' in the following reactions.
$\mathrm{Cl}_2 + \mathrm{NaOH}$ (Cold and dilute) $\rightarrow$ X + Y + Z
$\mathrm{Cl}_2 + \mathrm{NaOH}$ (Hot and concentrated) $\rightarrow$ X + A + Z
(a) NaCl (b) $\mathrm{NaClO}_4$
(c) $\mathrm{NaOCl}$ (d) $\mathrm{NaClO}_3$

13. Identify 'A', 'Y' and 'Z' in the following reaction.
$\mathrm{B} + \mathrm{A} \xrightarrow{\text{(Sunlight)}} \mathrm{Y:Y} + \mathrm{H}_2\mathrm{O} \rightarrow \mathrm{Z}; \mathrm{Z} + \mathrm{Zn} \rightarrow \mathrm{ZnCl}_2 + \mathrm{B}$
(a) $\mathrm{A} \rightarrow \mathrm{Cl}_2, \mathrm{Y} \rightarrow \mathrm{HCl}$ $\mathrm{Z} \rightarrow$ Hydrochloric acid
(b) $\mathrm{A} \rightarrow \mathrm{Cl}_2, \mathrm{Y} \rightarrow \mathrm{HCl}$ $\mathrm{Z} \rightarrow$ Hypochlorous acid
(c) $\mathrm{A} \rightarrow \mathrm{H}_2, \mathrm{Y} \rightarrow \mathrm{HCl}$ $\mathrm{Z} \rightarrow$ Hydrochloric acid
(d) $\mathrm{A} \rightarrow \mathrm{Cl}_2, \mathrm{Y} \rightarrow \mathrm{HCl}$ $\mathrm{Z} \rightarrow$ Chloric acid
